curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach solid, flashing and arrow signals in red, yellow and green, dark signals, pedestrian signals, and STOP and YIELD signs.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each signal and sign; contrast cards for flashing red versus flashing yellow and STOP versus YIELD.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that names a signal state and asks what the driver must do.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain what red-and-white, white and yellow signs mean, the wrong-way signs and reflectors, and how sign shapes code their meaning.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each sign family; contrast cards for bans versus standing rules versus warnings and for the sign shapes.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that names a sign color or shape and asks what it means.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover who goes first at intersections without signs, all-way stops, T junctions and turns, then how to drive a roundabout.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each right-of-way rule and roundabout step; contrast cards for first arrival versus the right-side tiebreak.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing two vehicles at an intersection and asking who goes first.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach who counts as a pedestrian and driver duties at crossings, blind pedestrians, steep passes, truck No Zones and stopping distances, and long vehicles.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for pedestrian, mountain and truck rules; contrast cards for car versus truck stopping distances.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz built on a crossing or a truck nearby.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain passing streetcars and light rail, sharing the road with motorcycles, and yielding to and staying back from emergency vehicles.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each sharing rule; contrast cards for pull-right-and-stop versus move-over.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that names a vehicle and asks how to share the road with it.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover slow vehicles such as neighborhood electric vehicles and horse-drawn traffic, cyclist rights and duties, night bike gear, and how to pass a cyclist.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for the bike lamp distances and the passing options.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a cyclist and asking what the rider or driver must do.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach work zone rules and fines, trucks and weather, school zone limits, school bus stops, blind intersection and rail crossing limits, and the must-not list.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each zone, crossing and prohibition; contrast cards for the fifteen and twenty-five limits.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps zone limits, fines and stopping distances.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover windshield and plate rules, funeral processions, penalties for evading police, court dates and points, provisional sanctions, and hearing rights.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each penalty and record rule; contrast cards for the point thresholds and provisional steps.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that names a violation or point count and asks what follows.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec07-m01..sec07-m08; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
